name: Perpetual derivatives leverage regime
description: Deterministic classification of the Bybit perpetual derivatives regime from three sub-states plus a stress override, carrying every factor it combined (SIG-045). basis_bps and basis_state are the published basis_bps and state of btc.cross.perp_spot_basis@1.0.0. funding_rate is the published funding_rate and funding_annualised_bps the published annualised_rate_bps of btc.bybit.funding_state@1.0.0; this identity does no annualisation of its own. funding_regime is the venue's published sign_regime, so the flat band is the one the venue identity already declares. oi_delta_pct_1m is the published delta_pct_1m of btc.bybit.open_interest_delta@1.0.0, in the percent units that identity publishes; open_interest_regime is rising above oi_threshold_pct, falling below its negation and flat otherwise, with oi_threshold_pct defaulting to 0.05. regime is evaluated in this fixed order. First, stress when btc.cross.liquidation_vs_spot_response@1.0.0 has published follow_through and its time_since_burst_ms is at or below stress_window_ms (default 300000). Otherwise the closed table on (basis_state, funding_regime, open_interest_regime): (contango, longs_pay, rising) is long_leverage_building; (contango, longs_pay, falling) is long_leverage_unwinding; (backwardation, shorts_pay, rising) is short_leverage_building; (backwardation, shorts_pay, falling) is short_leverage_unwinding. Every other combination, including any flat sub-state, is mixed. Ready output requires btc.cross.perp_spot_basis ready and the Bybit funding and open-interest identities ready and no more than 10000 milliseconds old. The liquidation input is deliberately NOT a readiness constituent: when no cascade has been observed the stress override cannot fire and stress_active publishes false, which is a correct reading rather than a missing one. The cross lane is Bybit-only (ruling E66 under E62): the {binance, bybit} venue set of the original spec §6.1 predates E62 and, from the Tokyo box, carries no Binance streams (rulings E30/E34), so a two-venue mean would make this regime structurally never ready. Bybit is the sole configured derivatives venue and is fully observable; venue_count is 1. The basis sub-state inherits btc.cross.perp_spot_basis@1.0.0, whose Bybit mark is converted to USD upstream through the Kraken USDT/USD reference (ruling E47), so every sub-state is a USD reading. No binance_* field or reason can appear on this lane. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
